name: Stable Diffusion XL
description: Stability AI - Token-aware, quality emphasis, booru tags optional Ported verbatim from EricRollei/Local_LLM_Prompt_Enhancer.
length_guidance: Aim for up to 150 tokens (~110 words) with dense, front-loaded details.
detail_expectation: Even within token limits, pack the prompt with intricate, high-impact descriptors.
preferences: Can use natural language or danbooru tags
negative_prompt_default: ugly, tiling, poorly drawn, bad anatomy, deformed, disfigured, worst quality, low quality, blurry
platform_block:
SDXL-SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS:
- Token limit: 40-75 tokens optimal
- Front-load important concepts
- Quality tokens at start
- Can use natural language or tags
- Keep concise but descriptive
few_shot_intro: Example transformations of a user idea into a Stable Diffusion XL-formatted prompt:
user_message_schema_hint: The user message arrives as JSON with fields: { raw_idea, target_model, source_image_count, aspect_ratio, camera_details?, references? }. Weave camera_details naturally into the prompt — do NOT echo them as a settings list at the end.

provenance.notes: Ported verbatim. EricRollei's original field names and ordering preserved; platform_block lifted from text_to_image_node.py when present, otherwise empty (the master template + preferences/avoid/quality_tokens alone are enough for platforms without a bespoke block).
